additional_info.body:
Dear Mert Kanneci,
I hope that You are well!
The charger is currently offline in SCB, so we can´t proceed with any action.
Usually this kind of cases are solved with the update of Linux and CFAST.
Please  understand why the charger is offline and if needed prepare a onsite intervention in order to identify what is causing this behavior to the charging station, the ticket will be forwarded to our expert team.
We really appreciate your help and look forward to getting this sorted out soon!
Best Regards,
Marcelo Kuester

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0469491-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/T4 314241502003] The device stuck on the 'Select charging point' screen CRM:02889000969
additional_info.body:
Hi Marcelo,
We conducted a site visit, and during our inspections, we identified that the device software had become corrupted.
The issue was resolved by updating the device software using a CFast card.
The field service report has been attached to the ticket. We may proceed with closing the ticket.
BR,
